findings.evidence: The diff adds a 6-line bullet to docs/design/explainer-site.md, which is not on the expected deliverables list. The text is accurate and documents the pages.yml change that the design doc describes, so it stops that doc going stale. I rate it minor, not harmful.

findings.summary: A failed records fetch only warns, so the deploy can still publish a 'branch missing' page
findings.evidence: `git fetch ... || echo "::warning::..."` means the build never fails when the fetch fails (for example, a private repository with persist-credentials: false). The comment and the page both say so, which is deliberate graceful handling. But a broken fetch would reach production with only a warning, not a red build.
role_limit reimplements the 'newest version of a role' lookup locally. The reading accepted this because athena-core is out of scope.

summary: The candidate passes: all 11 acceptance criteria are met, and nothing I found is blocker- or major-level. Both remaining points from the last attempt are fixed. First, the two fixture proposals now differ in title, rung, source (path vs job), evidence and raising role. The test asserts each brief's exact source line and that the two differ, so a fixed source line would now fail. Second, .github/workflows/pages.yml now fetches athena/records into refs/heads/athena/records in a step just before the site render, with the checkout pin and permissions unchanged. A test reads the real workflow file and fails if the fetch is missing or comes after the render. The rest of the earlier decisions-page work is kept and tested: the style doc quote, GitHub links at the branch tip, the 120-word and no-recommendation refusals, the 'not recorded' evidence text, recommendations from each role's recorded limit, the missing-branch page and the index link. `cargo test -p xtask` passes (60 unit tests plus all integration tests), and no new dependency was added. There are three non-blocking findings: docs/design/explainer-site.md changed although it is outside the deliverables list (an accurate doc update, minor); a failed fetch only warns and does not fail the build (minor); and role_limit duplicates logic from athena-core (nit). All results come from this snapshot only; the real repository's records branch is not present here.
